title: fidelity-trace.json
description: Per-VALID-slot fidelity decision TRACE, the load-bearing '全部落盘' audit artifact scheme §3/§8 mandate ('候选、显著度、绑定决策、判定路径全部落盘'; max/min '决策路径落盘'; hourly '判定路径落盘'). RULED (DECISIONS-M0 §7): this is a SEPARATE per-slot artifact at data/batches/<batch>/configs/<config_id>/slots/<k>/fidelity-trace.json — NOT inline in meta.json (meta.json keeps only the terminal verdict + scalar reason; the trace is deep-audit data). Present only for state=valid slots (the only ones with a fidelity verdict). Records: the candidate OCCURRENCE set (ID = (node preorder, start, end) + pattern_id, per-namespace, with same-span merge + category summary and label voiding), the leftmost-longest overlap arbitration log, the salience set E with f_max and per-candidate (f_max−f)/f_max, the max/min binding branch + distance 二元组 (DOM-edge count via LCA, |text-coordinate diff|) + assignment + canonical publication, the hourly pre-triage / label-parse / max-cardinality injective binding + fixed-length signature, and the decision path leading to every field verdict. JUDGMENT CALL (flagged): scheme fixes the fidelity SEMANTICS byte-exactly but not the trace JSON shape; the layout is this contract's design (DECISIONS-M0 §7). schema_version 1.0.0; file SHA256 + version frozen into lock (scheme §11).
$comment: schema_version: 1.0.0. IDs and distances are integers (occurrence-ID components are guaranteed < 2^31−1, scheme §3 sentinel claim). Displayed temperature values are canonical decimal STRINGS (mirrors meta.json, preserves ROUND_HALF_UP precision). Font sizes / salience ratios are JSON numbers; if this trace enters a verify rehash the runner fixes one canonical serialization (CONTRACT-NOTES §8). occurrence order = ID (node preorder,start,end) lexicographic. DOM preorder = pre-order traversal, siblings by child index.

extractor_version.description: extractor_version that produced this trace; frozen into lock (scheme §11). MUST equal meta.json.fidelity.extractor_version for the same slot.

slot_index.description: Slot number k; matches the slots/<k>/ directory and meta.json.slot_index. Only valid slots have a trace.

text_model.description: OPTIONAL: the normalized visible-text-node model used to compute text coordinates (DOM preorder, cumulative normalized-codepoint length, NO inter-node separator; scheme §3 文本坐标). Included when full distance auditability is retained; omit to keep the trace light.

node_preorder.description: DOM preorder index of the visible text node.

text_coord_base.description: Cumulative normalized-codepoint length before this node (its start text coordinate).

codepoint_length.description: Normalized-codepoint length of this node's text.

occurrences.description: Candidate occurrences after same-(node,start,end)-span merge + leftmost-longest arbitration (scheme §3). Ordered by ID (node preorder, start, end) lexicographic. Per-namespace pools; one text node may yield several occurrences.

pattern_id.description: Version-locked matcher pattern id that produced the hit (scheme §3, patterns versioned individually).

namespace.description: Occurrence pool (scheme §3 分池 by namespace).

merged_categories.description: Category summary of all raw hits sharing this (node,start,end) span (scheme §3 '同 span 合并汇总类别'). A label occurrence whose summary contains BOTH max and min is voided.

voided.description: true iff a label occurrence was voided because its merged same-span category summary contained both max and min (scheme §3). Voided labels drop out of the effective label set.

arbitration.description: Leftmost-longest overlap arbitration log (scheme §3): raw hits sorted by (start asc, length desc, pattern_id lexicographic), greedily keeping each hit not overlapping an already-selected one.

considered.description: Each raw hit considered in sort order, with the greedy selection outcome.

start.description: Node-internal Unicode codepoint offset (JS side must NOT use UTF-16 code-unit indexing).

selected.description: true if kept (did not overlap an already-selected hit).

salience.description: Temperature-candidate salience (scheme §3). f_max = max computed font-size (px) over all temperature-candidate occurrences' parent elements; null when there is no temperature candidate (E=∅). Same-salience band: (f_max−f)/f_max < 0.10.

f_max.description: Max parent computed font-size (px) over temperature candidates; null when no candidate.

candidates.description: Every temperature-candidate occurrence with its parent font-size and salience ratio.

font_size.description: Parent element computed font-size in px.

in_E.description: Member of the same-salience set E (salience_ratio < 0.10).

E.description: The same-salience temperature-candidate set E (occurrence IDs), scheme §3.

max_min_binding.description: Global one-to-one max/min binding (scheme §3, all v12 branches). Distances are the §3 二元组 (DOM-edge count via LCA, |text-coordinate diff|), compared lexicographically (first component then second).

branch.description: E-empty → both not-found (no-temperature-candidate), no canonical, no further branch (|E|=0). double-label = both effective label classes present. single-label = exactly one class. no-label = none (scheme §3).

distances.description: The candidate label→temperature distance 二元组 entries evaluated during binding. label_id null on the pure-numeric (no-label) side.

label_id.description: Label occurrence, or null on a numeric-rule side.

dom_edges.description: First distance component: DOM edge count from label parent to temperature parent via their LCA.

text_coord_diff.description: Second component: |text-coordinate(label) − text-coordinate(temperature)| in normalized codepoints.

canonical_published.description: true iff BOTH canonical occurrences produced with distinct IDs AND both max/min terminal states non-ambiguous (scheme §3 canonical publish condition). The scheme's explicit 'not-found 不发布' is covered by the first clause (not-found ⇒ no canonical occurrence produced ⇒ 'both produced' already fails). Gates hourly deduction.

decision_path.description: Ordered reason steps leading to the max/min verdicts (scheme §3 决策路径落盘).

hourly_binding.description: Hourly binding (scheme §3): pre-triage, then labeled max-cardinality injective binding or the no-label exactly-24 alignment. hourly_temperature_candidates = all temperature-candidate occurrences − the 2 canonical occurrences.

pretriage.description: proceed = both canonical published, continue. canonical-incomplete-ambiguous = temperature candidates exist but the two daily canonical occurrences not both published → whole field ambiguous. no-candidate-not-found = no temperature candidate → not-found (scheme §3 预分流).

has_label.description: true = labeled branch (max-cardinality injective binding). false = no-label branch (exactly 24 → aligned, else ambiguous). null when pre-triage stopped before this decision.

candidates.description: hourly_temperature_candidates (temperature occurrences minus the 2 canonical), occurrence IDs.

label_parse.description: Hourly-label occurrences and their parsed UTC hour (0–23) via the versioned template table; parsed_hour null when unparseable.

bindings.description: The chosen max-cardinality injective binding (labeled branch) or the ordered no-label alignment: each bound (label/hour → temperature) with its distance 二元组 components (labeled branch only; 0 for no-label).

label_id.description: Bound hourly-label occurrence; null on the no-label branch.

dom_edges.description: Distance 二元组 first component (labeled branch; 0 on no-label).

text_coord_diff.description: Distance 二元组 second component (labeled branch; 0 on no-label).

signature.description: Assignment signature = the T_id sequence of the fixed-length per-label vector (scheme §3 v12): bound element → the bound temperature occurrence ID; unbound label → the sentinel (2^31−1, 2^31−1, 2^31−1). Ordered by full label-occurrence order.

decision_path.description: Ordered reason steps for the hourly field verdict (scheme §3 判定路径落盘).

field_paths.description: Terminal verdict state + decision path for each fidelity field. States mirror meta.json (name is 2-state {match,not-found}; the rest are 4-state {match,mismatch,ambiguous,not-found}; hourly here is the FIELD-state aggregation, not the point states).

occId.description: Occurrence ID = (node preorder, start, end); each component a non-negative integer < 2^31−1 (scheme §3 sentinel guarantee). Occurrence order = this triple lexicographic.

occIdOrSentinel.description: An occurrence ID or the hourly-signature sentinel (2147483647,2147483647,2147483647) for an unbound label slot.

tempBinding.description: One side (max or min) of the binding result. label_id/temp_id/canonical_id null when not bound; value = the canonical occurrence's displayed decimal string (nullable).

canonical_id.description: Canonical occurrence (same value, smallest occurrence order); null when not published.

value.description: Displayed value as a canonical decimal string, or null.

display_decimals.description: Displayed decimal places d for ROUND_HALF_UP quantize (scheme §3), or null.

decisionPath.description: Ordered decision-path steps (scheme §3 全部落盘). Each step is a versioned code + optional detail.

namePath.description: name field verdict — 2-state only {match,not-found} (scheme §3 '无 mismatch 态').
